doc: Servo (Act 2 boss) only: the delivery-drone swarm and its parcels, metres and seconds (the sim converts to 60 Hz ticks); docs/bosses/servo.md is the design. drone: flight (cruise_mps, accel_mps2, sep_m keeps drones apart, fly_h_m the hover height, launch_s the climb out of the rack, hover_s over the drop ring before release, arrive_m), hp a drone's hit points as an arena body (1 = one round, as a human), ring_from_launch shows each drop ring from the drone's launch (true) or only over its hover (false, the owner call), life_s a fail-safe despawn, refill_s before an emptied rack cell holds a new drone. parcels: fall_s from release to the ground, bomb_share the chance (servo_swarm stream) a parcel is a bomb, else a CS crate that stays crate_life_s as an obstacle (crate_hp hits), ring_m the drop marker radius = the bomb blast radius. rack: the 12 cells (2 rows of 6 across the back, cell_dx_m apart, row_dy_m deep). phases: per phase the alive cap and the wave size and spread (spread_m between drop rings). kamikaze (phase 3): the drones fly to a ring standoff_m round the mark, each strike point tracks Rivet track_s then locks lock_s (the dodge cue), then a dive at dive_mps to a blast_m blast for damage; the drone is spent. depot: the arena dressing round the arena record's centre (metres): loading-bay doors (bays, bay_w_m wide) and the conveyor (from, to; belt_w_m wide), its belt running at belt_mps from phase 2 (rush hour).
